Convert a time of day to seconds and check its order

Source: R/get_route_frequency.R
time_of_day_window.Rd

Converts the from and to strings of a time of day to seconds after midnight, raising an error attributed to the calling function if from is not earlier than to. Unlike dwell_time_window(), both ends are required and they can't be equal. The callers validate the format of the strings themselves, so that those errors keep naming the user-facing function.

Usage

time_of_day_window(from, to)

Arguments

from, to

Strings in the "HH:MM:SS" format.

Value

An integer vector with from and to in seconds after midnight.
